'''Peace''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on [[Korbin]]. Like other cities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], such as [[Pleasant City]], [[Happy]], and [[Joy (city)|Joy]], it was lawless and controlled by criminals who cynically gave it its upbeat name, though conditions were not as severe as in Pleasant City. Because of this and its small size, Peace was known as a Small-Timer.
